context: A uni student catches up with his teen friend over coffee
purpose: Teach: 幾つ/およそ/まことに/どうにも/どれほど/暮らす/但し/かよう

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: さくら、久しぶり。最近どれほど忙しかったか、自分でも信じられないくらいだよ。
lines.en: Sakura, long time no see. You wouldn't believe how busy I've been lately.
lines.style: Warm reunion greeting, casual upperclassman tone, slightly tired but friendly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: れん先輩、本当にお久しぶりです！大学で一人暮らしするのって、どんな感じですか？
lines.en: Senpai Ren, it really has been ages! What's it like living alone at university?
lines.style: Bright teenage greeting, polite senpai address, curious and energetic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 正直、どうにも家事が苦手でさ。但し、自分のペースで暮らすのは思ったより気楽だよ。
lines.en: Honestly, I'm hopeless at housework. That said, living at my own pace is more carefree than I expected.
lines.style: Candid confession, slightly self-deprecating, relaxed conversational rhythm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: へぇ〜。ちなみに、バイトって幾つ掛け持ちしてるんですか？およそでいいです。
lines.en: Oh wow. By the way, how many part-time jobs are you juggling? A rough number is fine.
lines.style: Curious teen probing, casual filler interjection, asking for ballpark estimate.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今は二つ。一つはゼミ絡みで、マクロ経済の先生の下で物価指数や株価チャートのデータをまとめる係なんだ。媒体は主に新聞と業界誌だよ。
lines.en: Two right now. One is connected to my seminar, helping a macroeconomics professor compile data from price indexes and stock charts. The media we use are mostly newspapers and trade journals.
lines.style: Explanatory student tone, mildly proud, drops academic jargon naturally.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うわ、難しそう…。私なんて学校の図書館で雑誌のバックナンバーを刊行順に並べて、書架の整理状態を保持するだけの係ですよ。
lines.en: Whoa, sounds tough. Me, I'm just the one shelving magazine back issues in publication order at the school library, keeping the shelves tidy.
lines.style: Self-effacing teen humor, casual comparison, slight whiny inflection.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いや、それも立派な仕事だよ。そういうコツコツした作業って、集中力に良い影響を及ぼすって聞くしさ。
lines.en: No, that's a respectable job too. I've heard that kind of steady work has a good effect on your focus.
lines.style: Encouraging senpai mode, gently philosophical, sincere reassurance.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そう言ってもらえると嬉しいです。でも最近のニュース、まことに暗い話ばかりで…原油価格とか食糧危機とか厚生省の発表とか、正規の仕事も相対的に減ってるって本当ですか？
lines.en: Glad to hear you say that. But the news lately—crude oil prices, food crises, health ministry announcements—it's all gloomy, and they say full-time jobs are relatively decreasing too. Is that true?
lines.style: Anxious teen rant, rapid-fire concerns, looking for adult reassurance.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うちのゼミの先生は元秘書官で、入国管理の懇談会にも出てた人なんだけど、かような問題は適宜判断するしかないって言ってた。合成的な要因が絡んでて、消化するのに時間かかる重要な示唆だったよ。
lines.en: My seminar professor was a former secretary official who attended immigration discussion panels, and he said these kinds of issues you just have to judge case by case. It was an important hint—the composite factors are tangled and take time to digest.
lines.style: Thoughtful senpai sharing wisdom, name-dropping mentor, measured intellectual tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど…。あ、来月の文化祭の開幕イベント、ぜひ来てくださいね！叔母が癌の検診で来られなくて。究極の出し物を準備してるので、鞄からチケット取り出してお渡しします！
lines.en: I see. Oh, please come to next month's culture festival opening event! My aunt can't make it because of her cancer screening. We're preparing the ultimate show, so let me take the ticket out of my bag and hand it over!
lines.style: Brightening teen invitation, vulnerable family mention, eager to share ticket.
